newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at record, drugs sector jumps.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at record, drugs sector jumps.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse ended at a yet another record high on Thursday, helped by gains in the drug sector and export companies which rose because of a stronger dollar, dealers said.
The bourse's general index closed up 0.91 percent at 2,531.10, a record high, in lively trade totalling 5.98 billion crowns. The OMX index closed for the first time over 2,000.

Drug company Astra and telecommunications company Ericsson both rose because of the stronger dollar. Ericsson ended at 249, up 3.5 crowns. Astra jumped 11 crowns to 339.5 after U.S. pharmaceuticals rose overnight.
Foreign interest was keen for both companies, dealers said.
The forestry sector rose 1.54 percent. MoDo rose six crowns to 208 and Stora ended three crowns higher 95.
Electrical engineering group ABB climbed 19 crowns to 872.
